# ui-kit setup (once per project)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-ai-docs.mjs (npm run gen:ai). Do not edit by hand. -->

Run this once before installing any ui-kit component. Component docs check for `ui/styles/kit.css`; when it exists, setup is done.

## Instructions for the AI agent

1. **Check prerequisites.** React >=18.2 and react-dom, TypeScript, and **Tailwind CSS v4** (the global CSS starts with `@import "tailwindcss";`). Tailwind v3 is not supported: stop and tell the user. No other npm packages are needed.
2. **Pick the folder.** All files go in `ui/` inside the folder the `@/` import alias points to: `src/ui/` when the app has a `src/` folder, otherwise `./ui/`. Imports always read `@/ui/...`.
3. **Alias.** If `tsconfig.json` (or `jsconfig.json`) has no `@/*` path, add it (Next.js usually has it already). Vite also needs the same alias in `vite.config`:

   ```json
   {
     "compilerOptions": {
       "baseUrl": ".",
       "paths": { "@/*": ["./src/*"] }
     }
   }
   ```

   Use `["./*"]` instead when there is no `src/` folder.
4. **Create the files** under [Files](#files) verbatim (or run the download script), plus `ui/styles/kit.css` exactly as shown under [Entry CSS](#entry-css).
5. **Global CSS.** In the app's global stylesheet (Next.js: `app/globals.css` or `src/app/globals.css`), keep `@import "tailwindcss";` first and add the kit right after it. The path is relative to the stylesheet; for `app/globals.css` with `ui/` at the root, or `src/app/globals.css` with `src/ui/`, it is:

   ```css
   @import "tailwindcss";
   @import "../ui/styles/kit.css";
   ```

6. **Theme script** (applies the saved light/dark mode, accent and theme pack before the first paint). Next.js App Router, `app/layout.tsx`:

   ```tsx
   import { ThemeScript } from '@/ui/theme/theme-script';
   import './globals.css';

   export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
     return (
       <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
         <head>
           <ThemeScript />
         </head>
         <body>{children}</body>
       </html>
     );
   }
   ```

   Keep the app's existing layout and only add the import, `suppressHydrationWarning` on `<html>` and `<ThemeScript />` in `<head>`. Vite / plain React: put the string `themeBootScript` from `ui/theme/theme-script.tsx` in a `<script>` in `index.html`'s `<head>`. Client components switch theme with `useTheme()` from `@/ui/theme/use-theme`.
7. Tell the user setup is done, then continue with the component doc that sent you here.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Folder layout after setup

```text
ui/
  styles/
    kit.css              entry: tokens, base, motion, then one line per component
    tokens/ base.css motion.css
    components/<name>.css   added per component
  theme/                 ThemeScript and useTheme
  components/<name>/     added per component
  lib/ hooks/ icons/     shared helpers, added with the components that use them
```

## Entry CSS

### `ui/styles/kit.css`

```css
/* ui-kit entry, from ai/setup.md. Import it from your global CSS after @import "tailwindcss".
   Each component install doc adds one @import line above @source. */
@import "./tokens/palette.css";
@import "./tokens/semantic.css";
@import "./tokens/accents.css";
@import "./tokens/themes.css";
@import "./tokens/tailwind.css";
@import "./base.css";
@import "./motion.css";

/* Components (one line per installed component, added by its install doc) */

/* Let Tailwind see the utility classes used inside ui/ */
@source "..";
```

## Files

### `ui/styles/tokens/palette.css`

```css
/* ==========================================================================
   Layer 1 — raw palette. Components never read these directly; the semantic
   layer (semantic.css) and theme packs map them to roles.
   OKLCH throughout so lightness steps are perceptually even.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  /* Neutral (cool zinc) */
  --ui-gray-0: oklch(1 0 0);
  --ui-gray-25: oklch(0.99 0.001 286);
  --ui-gray-50: oklch(0.985 0.001 286);
  --ui-gray-100: oklch(0.967 0.002 286);
  --ui-gray-150: oklch(0.945 0.003 286);
  --ui-gray-200: oklch(0.92 0.004 286);
  --ui-gray-300: oklch(0.871 0.006 286);
  --ui-gray-400: oklch(0.705 0.015 286);
  --ui-gray-500: oklch(0.52 0.016 286);       /* muted text: ≥ 4.5:1 on white and on gray-100 */
  --ui-gray-600: oklch(0.442 0.017 286);
  --ui-gray-700: oklch(0.37 0.013 286);
  --ui-gray-800: oklch(0.274 0.006 286);
  --ui-gray-850: oklch(0.235 0.006 286);
  --ui-gray-900: oklch(0.21 0.006 286);
  --ui-gray-925: oklch(0.185 0.006 286);
  --ui-gray-950: oklch(0.141 0.005 286);
  --ui-gray-1000: oklch(0.11 0.004 286);

  /* Colour steps are named by role, not lightness alone:
     *-600 = solid fill under white text (≥ 4.5:1 with white)
     *-700 = text / icons on light surfaces and on 10–16% tints of the fill (≥ 4.5:1)
     *-300 = text / icons on dark surfaces (≥ 4.5:1 on gray-950)
     Contrast was measured, see scripts in the repo history (Phase 0). */

  /* Status */
  --ui-red-700: oklch(0.5 0.21 27);
  --ui-red-600: oklch(0.53 0.22 27);
  --ui-red-300: oklch(0.704 0.191 22.2);
  --ui-green-700: oklch(0.48 0.14 150);
  --ui-green-600: oklch(0.52 0.15 150);
  --ui-green-300: oklch(0.723 0.192 149.6);
  --ui-amber-500: oklch(0.769 0.165 70.1);     /* fill under dark text */
  --ui-amber-700: oklch(0.5 0.12 62);          /* warning text on light surfaces */
  --ui-amber-300: oklch(0.828 0.189 84.4);
  --ui-blue-700: oklch(0.51 0.2 263);
  --ui-blue-600: oklch(0.546 0.215 262.9);
  --ui-blue-300: oklch(0.68 0.17 259);

  /* Accent hues */
  --ui-violet-700: oklch(0.5 0.23 293);
  --ui-violet-600: oklch(0.541 0.247 293);
  --ui-violet-300: oklch(0.68 0.19 293);
  --ui-emerald-700: oklch(0.48 0.12 163);
  --ui-emerald-600: oklch(0.53 0.13 163);
  --ui-emerald-300: oklch(0.696 0.17 162.5);
  --ui-rose-700: oklch(0.52 0.2 17);
  --ui-rose-600: oklch(0.586 0.222 17.6);
  --ui-rose-300: oklch(0.7 0.19 17);
  --ui-orange-700: oklch(0.51 0.17 41);
  --ui-orange-600: oklch(0.56 0.19 41);
  --ui-orange-300: oklch(0.705 0.213 47.6);

  /* Data series */
  --ui-series-indigo: oklch(0.585 0.233 277.1);
  --ui-series-teal: oklch(0.696 0.17 162.5);
  --ui-series-amber: oklch(0.769 0.165 70.1);
  --ui-series-pink: oklch(0.645 0.246 16.4);
  --ui-series-sky: oklch(0.623 0.188 259.8);
  --ui-series-lime: oklch(0.768 0.204 130.9);
}
```

### `ui/styles/tokens/semantic.css`

```css
/* ==========================================================================
   Layer 2 — semantic roles. The only tokens components read.
   Light is the default; dark is `.dark` (or data-theme-mode="dark") on <html>.
   Theme packs (Phase 4) override this map, never the components.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --ui-radius: 0.625rem;

  /* Surfaces */
  --ui-background: var(--ui-gray-0);
  --ui-foreground: var(--ui-gray-950);
  --ui-surface: var(--ui-gray-0);              /* cards */
  --ui-surface-foreground: var(--ui-gray-950);
  --ui-surface-raised: var(--ui-gray-0);       /* popovers, menus, dialogs */
  --ui-surface-raised-foreground: var(--ui-gray-950);
  --ui-surface-muted: var(--ui-gray-100);      /* wells, table headers, muted fills */
  --ui-muted-foreground: var(--ui-gray-500);

  /* Interactive fills */
  --ui-primary: var(--ui-gray-900);
  --ui-primary-foreground: var(--ui-gray-50);
  --ui-secondary: var(--ui-gray-100);
  --ui-secondary-foreground: var(--ui-gray-900);
  --ui-accent: var(--ui-gray-100);             /* hover / highlighted item */
  --ui-accent-foreground: var(--ui-gray-900);

  /* Lines */
  --ui-border: var(--ui-gray-200);
  --ui-border-subtle: var(--ui-gray-150);
  --ui-border-strong: var(--ui-gray-300);      /* inputs */
  --ui-ring: var(--ui-gray-400);

  /* Selection controls (switch, checkbox, radio, slider) */
  --ui-control-on: var(--ui-primary);
  --ui-control-glyph: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
  --ui-control-track: var(--ui-gray-200);
  --ui-control-thumb: var(--ui-gray-0);

  /* Text in the brand colour (links, soft buttons, active items) */
  --ui-primary-text: var(--ui-gray-900);

  /* Status: fill (+ foreground on top of it) and text (on surfaces) */
  --ui-destructive: var(--ui-red-600);
  --ui-destructive-foreground: var(--ui-gray-0);
  --ui-destructive-text: var(--ui-red-700);
  --ui-success: var(--ui-green-600);
  --ui-success-foreground: var(--ui-gray-0);
  --ui-success-text: var(--ui-green-700);
  --ui-warning: var(--ui-amber-500);
  --ui-warning-foreground: var(--ui-gray-900);
  --ui-warning-text: var(--ui-amber-700);
  --ui-info: var(--ui-blue-600);
  --ui-info-foreground: var(--ui-gray-0);
  --ui-info-text: var(--ui-blue-700);

  /* Data series */
  --ui-series-1: var(--ui-series-indigo);
  --ui-series-2: var(--ui-series-teal);
  --ui-series-3: var(--ui-series-amber);
  --ui-series-4: var(--ui-series-pink);
  --ui-series-5: var(--ui-series-sky);
  --ui-series-6: var(--ui-series-lime);

  /* App chrome */
  --ui-sidebar: var(--ui-gray-50);
  --ui-sidebar-foreground: var(--ui-gray-950);
  --ui-sidebar-border: var(--ui-gray-200);
  --ui-sidebar-accent: var(--ui-gray-150);

  /* Elevation — only floating layers get shadows */
  --ui-shadow-xs: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05);
  --ui-shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 1px 3px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.06);
  --ui-shadow-md: 0 2px 4px -1px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 6px 16px -4px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.08);
  --ui-shadow-lg: 0 4px 8px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 16px 40px -8px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.14);
  --ui-overlay: oklch(0.15 0.01 286 / 0.45);

  color-scheme: light;
}

.dark,
[data-theme-mode="dark"] {
  --ui-background: var(--ui-gray-950);
  --ui-foreground: var(--ui-gray-50);
  --ui-surface: var(--ui-gray-925);
  --ui-surface-foreground: var(--ui-gray-50);
  --ui-surface-raised: var(--ui-gray-900);
  --ui-surface-raised-foreground: var(--ui-gray-50);
  --ui-surface-muted: var(--ui-gray-850);
  --ui-muted-foreground: var(--ui-gray-400);

  --ui-primary: var(--ui-gray-200);
  --ui-primary-foreground: var(--ui-gray-900);
  --ui-secondary: var(--ui-gray-800);
  --ui-secondary-foreground: var(--ui-gray-50);
  --ui-accent: var(--ui-gray-800);
  --ui-accent-foreground: var(--ui-gray-50);

  --ui-border: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.1);
  --ui-border-subtle: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.06);
  --ui-border-strong: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15);
  --ui-ring: var(--ui-gray-500);

  --ui-control-track: var(--ui-gray-700);
  --ui-control-thumb: var(--ui-gray-0);

  --ui-primary-text: var(--ui-gray-200);

  /* Fills stay at the -600 step (white text passes); text moves to -300 */
  --ui-destructive-text: var(--ui-red-300);
  --ui-success-text: var(--ui-green-300);
  --ui-warning: var(--ui-amber-300);
  --ui-warning-text: var(--ui-amber-300);
  --ui-info-text: var(--ui-blue-300);

  --ui-sidebar: var(--ui-gray-950);
  --ui-sidebar-foreground: var(--ui-gray-50);
  --ui-sidebar-border: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08);
  --ui-sidebar-accent: var(--ui-gray-850);

  --ui-shadow-xs: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3);
  --ui-shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 1px 3px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3);
  --ui-shadow-md: 0 2px 4px -1px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 6px 16px -4px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.45);
  --ui-shadow-lg: 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.06), 0 4px 8px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 16px 40px -8px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.6);
  --ui-overlay: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.6);

  color-scheme: dark;
}
```

### `ui/styles/tokens/accents.css`

```css
/* ==========================================================================
   Accent presets — swap the brand colour only.
   <html data-accent="violet|blue|emerald|rose|amber|orange">, or on any
   subtree. No attribute (or "neutral") keeps the monochrome default.

   Each accent has a fill (buttons, switches: ≥ 4.5:1 under its foreground)
   and a text colour (links, soft buttons: ≥ 4.5:1 on the page background).
   ========================================================================== */

[data-accent="violet"] { --ui-accent-fill: var(--ui-violet-600); --ui-accent-text-light: var(--ui-violet-700); --ui-accent-text-dark: var(--ui-violet-300); }
[data-accent="blue"] { --ui-accent-fill: var(--ui-blue-600); --ui-accent-text-light: var(--ui-blue-700); --ui-accent-text-dark: var(--ui-blue-300); }
[data-accent="emerald"] { --ui-accent-fill: var(--ui-emerald-600); --ui-accent-text-light: var(--ui-emerald-700); --ui-accent-text-dark: var(--ui-emerald-300); }
[data-accent="rose"] { --ui-accent-fill: var(--ui-rose-600); --ui-accent-text-light: var(--ui-rose-700); --ui-accent-text-dark: var(--ui-rose-300); }
[data-accent="orange"] { --ui-accent-fill: var(--ui-orange-600); --ui-accent-text-light: var(--ui-orange-700); --ui-accent-text-dark: var(--ui-orange-300); }
[data-accent="amber"] { --ui-accent-fill: var(--ui-amber-500); --ui-accent-text-light: var(--ui-amber-700); --ui-accent-text-dark: var(--ui-amber-300); }

[data-accent]:not([data-accent="neutral"]) {
  --ui-primary: var(--ui-accent-fill);
  --ui-primary-foreground: var(--ui-gray-0);
  --ui-primary-text: var(--ui-accent-text-light);
  --ui-ring: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-accent-fill) 70%, var(--ui-background));
  --ui-control-on: var(--ui-accent-fill);
  --ui-control-glyph: var(--ui-gray-0);
}

.dark[data-accent]:not([data-accent="neutral"]),
.dark [data-accent]:not([data-accent="neutral"]) {
  --ui-primary-text: var(--ui-accent-text-dark);
}

/* Amber is light: dark text on top of it */
[data-accent="amber"][data-accent] {
  --ui-primary-foreground: var(--ui-gray-900);
  --ui-control-glyph: var(--ui-gray-900);
}
```

### `ui/styles/tokens/themes/engine.css`

```css
/* ==========================================================================
   Theme pack engine. Packs (stone.css, slate.css…) only set the tone ramp
   and knobs below; this file maps them to the semantic roles.

   Why knobs instead of overriding --ui-* directly in each pack:
   - Custom properties resolve where they are declared. --ui-control-on,
     --ui-ring and --radius-* are computed once at :root, so a pack on a
     subtree has to re-declare them there, with its own values in scope.
   - One pair of maps keeps the light/dark/accent precedence in one place,
     instead of five packs each re-solving selector specificity.

   Specificity (all unlayered, so they beat Tailwind's @layer theme):
     knobs        [data-theme]                         0,1,0  (packs: later)
     dark map     .dark[data-theme], .dark [data-theme],
                  [data-theme] .dark (+ data-theme-mode="dark")   0,2,0
     light map    [data-theme]                         0,1,0
                  [data-theme][data-theme-mode="light"] 0,2,0  (after dark)
   ========================================================================== */

/* 1. Neutral defaults: zinc ramp + role knobs ------------------------------ */
[data-theme] {
  --ui-tone-0: var(--ui-gray-0);
  --ui-tone-50: var(--ui-gray-50);
  --ui-tone-100: var(--ui-gray-100);
  --ui-tone-150: var(--ui-gray-150);
  --ui-tone-200: var(--ui-gray-200);
  --ui-tone-300: var(--ui-gray-300);
  --ui-tone-400: var(--ui-gray-400);
  --ui-tone-500: var(--ui-gray-500);
  --ui-tone-700: var(--ui-gray-700);
  --ui-tone-800: var(--ui-gray-800);
  --ui-tone-850: var(--ui-gray-850);
  --ui-tone-900: var(--ui-gray-900);
  --ui-tone-925: var(--ui-gray-925);
  --ui-tone-950: var(--ui-gray-950);

  --ui-pack-radius: 0.625rem;

  /* Light */
  --ui-pack-background: var(--ui-tone-0);
  --ui-pack-foreground: var(--ui-tone-950);
  --ui-pack-surface: var(--ui-tone-0);
  --ui-pack-surface-raised: var(--ui-tone-0);
  --ui-pack-surface-muted: var(--ui-tone-100);
  --ui-pack-muted-foreground: var(--ui-tone-500);
  --ui-pack-primary: var(--ui-tone-900);
  --ui-pack-primary-foreground: var(--ui-tone-50);
  --ui-pack-primary-text: var(--ui-tone-900);
  --ui-pack-secondary: var(--ui-tone-100);
  --ui-pack-secondary-foreground: var(--ui-tone-900);
  --ui-pack-accent: var(--ui-tone-100);
  --ui-pack-border: var(--ui-tone-200);
  --ui-pack-border-subtle: var(--ui-tone-150);
  --ui-pack-border-strong: var(--ui-tone-300);
  --ui-pack-ring: var(--ui-tone-400);
  --ui-pack-control-track: var(--ui-tone-200);
  --ui-pack-sidebar: var(--ui-tone-50);
  --ui-pack-sidebar-border: var(--ui-tone-200);
  --ui-pack-sidebar-accent: var(--ui-tone-150);
  --ui-pack-shadow-xs: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05);
  --ui-pack-shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 1px 3px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.06);
  --ui-pack-shadow-md: 0 2px 4px -1px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 6px 16px -4px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.08);
  --ui-pack-shadow-lg: 0 4px 8px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 16px 40px -8px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.14);
  --ui-pack-overlay: oklch(0.15 0.01 286 / 0.45);

  /* Dark */
  --ui-pack-background-dark: var(--ui-tone-950);
  --ui-pack-foreground-dark: var(--ui-tone-50);
  --ui-pack-surface-dark: var(--ui-tone-925);
  --ui-pack-surface-raised-dark: var(--ui-tone-900);
  --ui-pack-surface-muted-dark: var(--ui-tone-850);
  --ui-pack-muted-foreground-dark: var(--ui-tone-400);
  --ui-pack-primary-dark: var(--ui-tone-200);
  --ui-pack-primary-foreground-dark: var(--ui-tone-900);
  --ui-pack-primary-text-dark: var(--ui-tone-200);
  --ui-pack-secondary-dark: var(--ui-tone-800);
  --ui-pack-secondary-foreground-dark: var(--ui-tone-50);
  --ui-pack-accent-dark: var(--ui-tone-800);
  --ui-pack-border-dark: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.1);
  --ui-pack-border-subtle-dark: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.06);
  --ui-pack-border-strong-dark: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15);
  --ui-pack-ring-dark: var(--ui-tone-500);
  --ui-pack-control-track-dark: var(--ui-tone-700);
  --ui-pack-sidebar-dark: var(--ui-tone-950);
  --ui-pack-sidebar-border-dark: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08);
  --ui-pack-sidebar-accent-dark: var(--ui-tone-850);
  --ui-pack-shadow-xs-dark: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3);
  --ui-pack-shadow-sm-dark: 0 1px 2px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 1px 3px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3);
  --ui-pack-shadow-md-dark: 0 2px 4px -1px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 6px 16px -4px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.45);
  --ui-pack-shadow-lg-dark: 0 0 0 1px oklch(1 0 0 / 0.06), 0 4px 8px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 16px 40px -8px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.6);
  --ui-pack-overlay-dark: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.6);
}

/* 2. Accent hand-off. accents.css sets --ui-accent-fill / -text-* on the
      accent element; these two helpers let the maps below fall back to the
      pack's own primary when no accent is set. */
[data-accent]:not([data-accent="neutral"]) {
  --ui-accent-on: var(--ui-gray-0);
  --ui-accent-ring-mix: 70%;
}
[data-accent="amber"][data-accent] { --ui-accent-on: var(--ui-gray-900); }

/* 3. Dark map ------------------------------------------------------------- */
.dark[data-theme],
.dark [data-theme],
[data-theme] .dark,
[data-theme-mode="dark"][data-theme],
[data-theme-mode="dark"] [data-theme],
[data-theme] [data-theme-mode="dark"] {
  --ui-background: var(--ui-pack-background-dark);
  --ui-foreground: var(--ui-pack-foreground-dark);
  --ui-surface: var(--ui-pack-surface-dark);
  --ui-surface-foreground: var(--ui-pack-foreground-dark);
  --ui-surface-raised: var(--ui-pack-surface-raised-dark);
  --ui-surface-raised-foreground: var(--ui-pack-foreground-dark);
  --ui-surface-muted: var(--ui-pack-surface-muted-dark);
  --ui-muted-foreground: var(--ui-pack-muted-foreground-dark);

  --ui-primary: var(--ui-accent-fill, var(--ui-pack-primary-dark));
  --ui-primary-foreground: var(--ui-accent-on, var(--ui-pack-primary-foreground-dark));
  --ui-primary-text: var(--ui-accent-text-dark, var(--ui-pack-primary-text-dark));
  --ui-secondary: var(--ui-pack-secondary-dark);
  --ui-secondary-foreground: var(--ui-pack-secondary-foreground-dark);
  --ui-accent: var(--ui-pack-accent-dark);
  --ui-accent-foreground: var(--ui-pack-secondary-foreground-dark);

  --ui-border: var(--ui-pack-border-dark);
  --ui-border-subtle: var(--ui-pack-border-subtle-dark);
  --ui-border-strong: var(--ui-pack-border-strong-dark);
  --ui-ring: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-accent-fill, var(--ui-pack-ring-dark)) var(--ui-accent-ring-mix, 100%), var(--ui-background));

  --ui-control-on: var(--ui-primary);
  --ui-control-glyph: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
  --ui-control-track: var(--ui-pack-control-track-dark);
  --ui-control-thumb: var(--ui-gray-0);

  --ui-destructive-text: var(--ui-red-300);
  --ui-success-text: var(--ui-green-300);
  --ui-warning: var(--ui-amber-300);
  --ui-warning-text: var(--ui-amber-300);
  --ui-info-text: var(--ui-blue-300);

  --ui-sidebar: var(--ui-pack-sidebar-dark);
  --ui-sidebar-foreground: var(--ui-pack-foreground-dark);
  --ui-sidebar-border: var(--ui-pack-sidebar-border-dark);
  --ui-sidebar-accent: var(--ui-pack-sidebar-accent-dark);

  --ui-shadow-xs: var(--ui-pack-shadow-xs-dark);
  --ui-shadow-sm: var(--ui-pack-shadow-sm-dark);
  --ui-shadow-md: var(--ui-pack-shadow-md-dark);
  --ui-shadow-lg: var(--ui-pack-shadow-lg-dark);
  --ui-overlay: var(--ui-pack-overlay-dark);

  color-scheme: dark;
}

/* 4. Light map + mode-independent tokens. After the dark map so that
      data-theme-mode="light" on a pack element wins inside a dark page. */
[data-theme],
[data-theme][data-theme-mode="light"] {
  --ui-radius: var(--ui-pack-radius);
  /* Same formulas as tokens/tailwind.css, re-declared so a subtree's radius
     is resolved against its own --ui-radius, not the one at :root. */
  --radius-xs: max(2px, calc(var(--ui-radius) - 6px));
  --radius-sm: max(3px, calc(var(--ui-radius) - 4px));
  --radius-md: max(4px, calc(var(--ui-radius) - 2px));
  --radius-lg: var(--ui-radius);
  --radius-xl: calc(var(--ui-radius) + 4px);
  --radius-2xl: calc(var(--ui-radius) + 8px);

  --ui-background: var(--ui-pack-background);
  --ui-foreground: var(--ui-pack-foreground);
  --ui-surface: var(--ui-pack-surface);
  --ui-surface-foreground: var(--ui-pack-foreground);
  --ui-surface-raised: var(--ui-pack-surface-raised);
  --ui-surface-raised-foreground: var(--ui-pack-foreground);
  --ui-surface-muted: var(--ui-pack-surface-muted);
  --ui-muted-foreground: var(--ui-pack-muted-foreground);

  --ui-primary: var(--ui-accent-fill, var(--ui-pack-primary));
  --ui-primary-foreground: var(--ui-accent-on, var(--ui-pack-primary-foreground));
  --ui-primary-text: var(--ui-accent-text-light, var(--ui-pack-primary-text));
  --ui-secondary: var(--ui-pack-secondary);
  --ui-secondary-foreground: var(--ui-pack-secondary-foreground);
  --ui-accent: var(--ui-pack-accent);
  --ui-accent-foreground: var(--ui-pack-secondary-foreground);

  --ui-border: var(--ui-pack-border);
  --ui-border-subtle: var(--ui-pack-border-subtle);
  --ui-border-strong: var(--ui-pack-border-strong);
  --ui-ring: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-accent-fill, var(--ui-pack-ring)) var(--ui-accent-ring-mix, 100%), var(--ui-background));

  --ui-control-on: var(--ui-primary);
  --ui-control-glyph: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
  --ui-control-track: var(--ui-pack-control-track);
  --ui-control-thumb: var(--ui-gray-0);

  --ui-destructive-text: var(--ui-red-700);
  --ui-success-text: var(--ui-green-700);
  --ui-warning: var(--ui-amber-500);
  --ui-warning-text: var(--ui-amber-700);
  --ui-info-text: var(--ui-blue-700);

  --ui-sidebar: var(--ui-pack-sidebar);
  --ui-sidebar-foreground: var(--ui-pack-foreground);
  --ui-sidebar-border: var(--ui-pack-sidebar-border);
  --ui-sidebar-accent: var(--ui-pack-sidebar-accent);

  --ui-shadow-xs: var(--ui-pack-shadow-xs);
  --ui-shadow-sm: var(--ui-pack-shadow-sm);
  --ui-shadow-md: var(--ui-pack-shadow-md);
  --ui-shadow-lg: var(--ui-pack-shadow-lg);
  --ui-overlay: var(--ui-pack-overlay);

  color-scheme: light;
}

/* A nested pack takes the page's display face back from mono */
[data-theme="mono"] [data-theme]:not([data-theme="mono"]) { --ui-font-display: var(--ui-font-sans); }
```

### `ui/styles/tokens/themes/mono.css`

```css
/* ==========================================================================
   Mono — brutal-lite: pure greys, ink-black primary, strong borders instead
   of shadows, small corners (4px base; tailwind.css floors radii at 2–4px)
   and monospaced display headings.
   Lowest text pair: muted text on surface-muted, 5.42:1 (light);
   status text on surface-muted, 5.39:1 (dark).
   ========================================================================== */

[data-theme="mono"] {
  --ui-tone-0: oklch(1 0 0);
  --ui-tone-50: oklch(0.985 0 0);
  --ui-tone-100: oklch(0.965 0 0);
  --ui-tone-150: oklch(0.94 0 0);
  --ui-tone-200: oklch(0.915 0 0);
  --ui-tone-300: oklch(0.86 0 0);
  --ui-tone-400: oklch(0.7 0 0);
  --ui-tone-500: oklch(0.5 0 0);
  --ui-tone-700: oklch(0.37 0 0);
  --ui-tone-800: oklch(0.27 0 0);
  --ui-tone-850: oklch(0.235 0 0);
  --ui-tone-900: oklch(0.205 0 0);
  --ui-tone-925: oklch(0.18 0 0);
  --ui-tone-950: oklch(0.13 0 0);

  --ui-pack-radius: 0.25rem;

  --ui-pack-primary: var(--ui-tone-950);
  --ui-pack-primary-foreground: var(--ui-tone-0);
  --ui-pack-primary-text: var(--ui-tone-950);
  --ui-pack-border: var(--ui-tone-800);
  --ui-pack-border-subtle: var(--ui-tone-200);
  --ui-pack-border-strong: var(--ui-tone-800);
  --ui-pack-ring: var(--ui-tone-500);
  --ui-pack-sidebar-border: var(--ui-tone-800);

  --ui-pack-primary-dark: var(--ui-tone-0);
  --ui-pack-primary-foreground-dark: var(--ui-tone-950);
  --ui-pack-primary-text-dark: var(--ui-tone-0);
  --ui-pack-border-dark: var(--ui-tone-400);
  --ui-pack-border-subtle-dark: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.12);
  --ui-pack-border-strong-dark: var(--ui-tone-400);
  --ui-pack-sidebar-border-dark: var(--ui-tone-400);

  /* No shadows. Zero-size transparent shadows (not `none`) so a component
     that stacks a focus ring after a shadow still gets a valid list. */
  --ui-pack-shadow-xs: 0 0 0 0 transparent;
  --ui-pack-shadow-sm: 0 0 0 0 transparent;
  --ui-pack-shadow-md: 0 0 0 0 transparent;
  --ui-pack-shadow-lg: 0 0 0 0 transparent;
  --ui-pack-shadow-xs-dark: 0 0 0 0 transparent;
  --ui-pack-shadow-sm-dark: 0 0 0 0 transparent;
  --ui-pack-shadow-md-dark: 0 0 0 0 transparent;
  --ui-pack-shadow-lg-dark: 0 0 0 0 transparent;
  --ui-pack-overlay: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.5);
}

/* Doubled attribute: beats the later `:root { --ui-font-display }` in base.css */
[data-theme="mono"][data-theme] { --ui-font-display: var(--ui-font-mono); }
```

### `ui/styles/tokens/themes.css`

```css
/* ==========================================================================
   Layer 3 — theme packs. A pack changes the whole look (colour map in light
   and dark, radius, shadows, display face) by overriding semantic tokens
   only; component CSS never changes.

     <html data-theme="stone">          whole app
     <section data-theme="soft">        any subtree
     <div data-theme="slate" class="dark">                 subtree in dark
     <div data-theme="slate" data-theme-mode="light">      subtree in light,
                                                           even on a dark page

   Packs: neutral (default, same as no attribute), stone, slate, soft, mono.
   They compose with `.dark` / data-theme-mode and with data-accent: an
   accent always wins over the pack's own primary colour.

   How it works (themes/engine.css):
     1. Every [data-theme] element gets a tone ramp (--ui-tone-*) and a set
        of role knobs (--ui-pack-*, --ui-pack-*-dark) with neutral defaults.
     2. A pack file overrides the ramp and only the knobs it cares about.
     3. Two shared maps turn the knobs into the semantic roles (--ui-*), one
        for light and one for dark, on the same element. Re-declaring every
        role there is what lets a pack (or `neutral`) reset a subtree.

   @imports must stay first in this file; the engine must come before packs.
   ========================================================================== */

@import "./themes/engine.css";
@import "./themes/stone.css";
@import "./themes/slate.css";
@import "./themes/soft.css";
@import "./themes/mono.css";
```

### `ui/styles/tokens/tailwind.css`

```css
/* ==========================================================================
   Tailwind bridge — semantic roles become Tailwind colours, so `bg-card`,
   `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`, `bg-series-1` follow the theme.
   Also defines our type scale, radii and shadows.
   ========================================================================== */

@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *, [data-theme-mode="dark"], [data-theme-mode="dark"] *));

@theme inline {
  --font-sans: var(--ui-font-sans);
  --font-display: var(--ui-font-display);
  --font-mono: var(--ui-font-mono);

  --color-background: var(--ui-background);
  --color-foreground: var(--ui-foreground);
  --color-card: var(--ui-surface);
  --color-card-foreground: var(--ui-surface-foreground);
  --color-popover: var(--ui-surface-raised);
  --color-popover-foreground: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
  --color-muted: var(--ui-surface-muted);
  --color-muted-foreground: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  --color-primary: var(--ui-primary);
  --color-primary-foreground: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
  --color-primary-text: var(--ui-primary-text);
  --color-secondary: var(--ui-secondary);
  --color-secondary-foreground: var(--ui-secondary-foreground);
  --color-accent: var(--ui-accent);
  --color-accent-foreground: var(--ui-accent-foreground);
  --color-border: var(--ui-border);
  --color-border-subtle: var(--ui-border-subtle);
  --color-input: var(--ui-border-strong);
  --color-ring: var(--ui-ring);
  --color-destructive: var(--ui-destructive);
  --color-destructive-foreground: var(--ui-destructive-foreground);
  --color-destructive-text: var(--ui-destructive-text);
  --color-success: var(--ui-success);
  --color-success-foreground: var(--ui-success-foreground);
  --color-success-text: var(--ui-success-text);
  --color-warning: var(--ui-warning);
  --color-warning-foreground: var(--ui-warning-foreground);
  --color-warning-text: var(--ui-warning-text);
  --color-info: var(--ui-info);
  --color-info-foreground: var(--ui-info-foreground);
  --color-info-text: var(--ui-info-text);
  --color-series-1: var(--ui-series-1);
  --color-series-2: var(--ui-series-2);
  --color-series-3: var(--ui-series-3);
  --color-series-4: var(--ui-series-4);
  --color-series-5: var(--ui-series-5);
  --color-series-6: var(--ui-series-6);
  --color-sidebar: var(--ui-sidebar);
  --color-sidebar-foreground: var(--ui-sidebar-foreground);
  --color-sidebar-border: var(--ui-sidebar-border);
  --color-sidebar-accent: var(--ui-sidebar-accent);

  --radius-xs: max(2px, calc(var(--ui-radius) - 6px));
  --radius-sm: max(3px, calc(var(--ui-radius) - 4px));
  --radius-md: max(4px, calc(var(--ui-radius) - 2px));
  --radius-lg: var(--ui-radius);
  --radius-xl: calc(var(--ui-radius) + 4px);
  --radius-2xl: calc(var(--ui-radius) + 8px);

  --shadow-xs: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
  --shadow-sm: var(--ui-shadow-sm);
  --shadow-md: var(--ui-shadow-md);
  --shadow-lg: var(--ui-shadow-lg);
}

/* Type scale: 12 / 13 / 14 / 15 / 17 / 20 / 24 / 28 / 34 / 40 */
@theme {
  --text-xs: 0.75rem;
  --text-xs--line-height: 1rem;
  --text-sm: 0.8125rem;
  --text-sm--line-height: 1.25rem;
  --text-base: 0.875rem;
  --text-base--line-height: 1.375rem;
  --text-md: 0.9375rem;
  --text-md--line-height: 1.5rem;
  --text-lg: 1.0625rem;
  --text-lg--line-height: 1.625rem;
  --text-xl: 1.25rem;
  --text-xl--line-height: 1.75rem;
  --text-2xl: 1.5rem;
  --text-2xl--line-height: 2rem;
  --text-3xl: 1.75rem;
  --text-3xl--line-height: 2.125rem;
  --text-4xl: 2.125rem;
  --text-4xl--line-height: 2.5rem;
```

```css
/* ==========================================================================
   Base — defaults on top of Tailwind preflight.
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --ui-font-sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --ui-font-display: var(--ui-font-sans);
  --ui-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;
}

@layer base {
  * { border-color: var(--ui-border); }
  html {
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
    text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  }
  body {
    background-color: var(--ui-background);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-family: var(--ui-font-sans);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: var(--text-base--line-height);
  }
  ::selection { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 22%, transparent); }

  /* Keyboard focus gets a ring; pointer focus does not */
  :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 75%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

  [hidden]:where(:not([hidden="until-found"])) { display: none !important; }

  /* Native top-layer elements start unstyled; components style them */
  dialog, [popover] { color: inherit; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; max-width: none; max-height: none; overflow: visible; }
  dialog::backdrop, [popover]::backdrop { background: transparent; }

  * { scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 18%, transparent) transparent; }
}
```

```css
/* ==========================================================================
   Motion — the "soft rise" signature.
   Entrances rise 4–8px with a light blur and scale ≥ .96; exits are faster.
   Spring presets are real damped-spring curves (scripts/gen-springs.mjs).
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  --ui-duration-instant: 100ms;
  --ui-duration-fast: 150ms;
  --ui-duration-exit: 160ms;
  --ui-duration: 220ms;
  --ui-duration-slow: 380ms;

  --ui-ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  --ui-ease-in: cubic-bezier(0.55, 0, 1, 0.45);
  --ui-ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
  --ui-ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);

  /* snappy: press feedback, small indicators — perceptual 260ms, bounce .12 */
  --ui-spring-snappy: linear(0, 0.0118, 0.043, 0.088, 0.1426, 0.2029, 0.2664, 0.3307, 0.3943, 0.4558, 0.5144, 0.5694, 0.6206, 0.6677, 0.7107, 0.7496, 0.7845, 0.8157, 0.8433, 0.8677, 0.889, 0.9075, 0.9236, 0.9374, 0.9492, 0.9593, 0.9678, 0.9749, 0.9808, 0.9857, 0.9897, 0.993, 0.9956, 0.9976, 0.9992, 1.0005, 1.0014, 1.002, 1.0025, 1.0028, 1.0029, 1.003, 1.0029, 1.0028, 1.0027, 1.0026, 1.0024, 1.0022, 1);
  --ui-spring-snappy-duration: 320ms;
  /* smooth: panels, height, drawers, progress — never overshoots */
  --ui-spring-smooth: linear(0, 0.0139, 0.0495, 0.0995, 0.1582, 0.2215, 0.2864, 0.3507, 0.4129, 0.472, 0.5273, 0.5786, 0.6256, 0.6685, 0.7073, 0.7423, 0.7736, 0.8015, 0.8263, 0.8483, 0.8677, 0.8848, 0.8998, 0.913, 0.9246, 0.9347, 0.9435, 0.9511, 0.9578, 0.9636, 0.9686, 0.9729, 0.9767, 0.98, 0.9828, 0.9852, 0.9873, 0.9891, 0.9906, 0.992, 0.9931, 0.9941, 0.995, 0.9957, 0.9963, 0.9968, 0.9973, 0.9977, 1);
  --ui-spring-smooth-duration: 540ms;
  /* morph: gliding highlights, width that follows content — bounce .16 */
  --ui-spring-morph: linear(0, 0.0133, 0.0485, 0.0991, 0.1599, 0.227, 0.2969, 0.3673, 0.4361, 0.5021, 0.5643, 0.622, 0.6749, 0.7228, 0.7658, 0.804, 0.8377, 0.867, 0.8924, 0.9142, 0.9327, 0.9483, 0.9613, 0.9721, 0.9808, 0.9879, 0.9935, 0.9979, 1.0012, 1.0036, 1.0054, 1.0066, 1.0073, 1.0076, 1.0077, 1.0076, 1.0073, 1.0069, 1.0064, 1.0059, 1.0053, 1.0048, 1.0042, 1.0037, 1.0033, 1.0028, 1.0024, 1.0021, 1);
  --ui-spring-morph-duration: 550ms;

  --ui-stagger: 35ms;
  --ui-blur-subtle: 2px;
  --ui-blur-soft: 4px;
}

@theme {
  --animate-rise: ui-rise-in var(--ui-duration-slow) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  --animate-pop: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  --animate-fade: ui-fade-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  --animate-shimmer: ui-shimmer 1.6s linear infinite;
  --animate-spin: ui-spin 0.7s linear infinite;

  @keyframes ui-rise-in {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) scale(0.985); filter: blur(var(--ui-blur-soft)); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; }
  }
  @keyframes ui-pop-in {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(var(--ui-pop-y, 0)) scale(0.96); filter: blur(var(--ui-blur-subtle)); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; }
  }
  @keyframes ui-fade-in {
    from { opacity: 0; }
    to { opacity: 1; }
  }
  @keyframes ui-shimmer {
    from { background-position: 200% 0; }
    to { background-position: -200% 0; }
  }
  @keyframes ui-spin {
    to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
  }
}

@keyframes ui-pop-out {
  from { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; }
  to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(var(--ui-pop-y, 0)) scale(0.97); filter: blur(var(--ui-blur-subtle)); }
}
@keyframes ui-fade-out { from { opacity: 1; } to { opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes ui-slide-in-right { from { transform: translateX(100%); } }
@keyframes ui-slide-out-right { to { transform: translateX(100%); } }
@keyframes ui-slide-in-left { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } }
@keyframes ui-slide-out-left { to { transform: translateX(-100%); } }
@keyframes ui-slide-in-top { from { transform: translateY(-100%); } }
@keyframes ui-slide-out-top { to { transform: translateY(-100%); } }
@keyframes ui-slide-in-bottom { from { transform: translateY(100%); } }
@keyframes ui-slide-out-bottom { to { transform: translateY(100%); } }
@keyframes ui-draw { from { stroke-dashoffset: var(--ui-dash, 1000); } to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }

@layer components {
  .ui-animate-rise { animation: var(--animate-rise); }
  .ui-animate-pop { animation: var(--animate-pop); }
  .ui-animate-fade { animation: var(--animate-fade); }

  /* Stagger children — one orchestrated entrance per view, total < 400ms */
  .ui-stagger > * { animation: var(--animate-rise); animation-delay: calc(var(--ui-i, 0) * var(--ui-stagger)); }
  .ui-stagger > :nth-child(2) { --ui-i: 1; }
  .ui-stagger > :nth-child(3) { --ui-i: 2; }
  .ui-stagger > :nth-child(4) { --ui-i: 3; }
  .ui-stagger > :nth-child(5) { --ui-i: 4; }
  .ui-stagger > :nth-child(6) { --ui-i: 5; }
  .ui-stagger > :nth-child(7) { --ui-i: 6; }
  .ui-stagger > :nth-child(8) { --ui-i: 7; }
  .ui-stagger > :nth-child(n + 9) { --ui-i: 8; }
}

/* Reduced motion: the state changes, the movement doesn't */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 1ms !important;
    animation-delay: 0ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 1ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}
```

### `ui/theme/theme-script.tsx`

```tsx
/**
 * <ThemeScript /> — put it in <head> (Next.js: app/layout.tsx). It applies the
 * saved mode, accent and theme pack before the first paint, so there is no
 * light flash and no flash of the default pack.
 * Server Component–safe. Pair with `useTheme()` in client components.
 */

export const THEME_STORAGE = { mode: 'ui-theme-mode', accent: 'ui-theme-accent', pack: 'ui-theme-pack' } as const;

/** Built-in theme packs (styles/tokens/themes). `neutral` = no `data-theme` attribute. */
export type ThemePack = 'neutral' | 'stone' | 'slate' | 'soft' | 'mono';
export const THEME_PACKS: ThemePack[] = ['neutral', 'stone', 'slate', 'soft', 'mono'];

/**
 * Pack: nothing saved → leave whatever the server rendered (`<html data-theme="stone">`);
 * saved `neutral` → remove the attribute; any other saved name → set it.
 * Names are limited to [a-z0-9-] so a tampered value can't do anything odd.
 */
export const themeBootScript = `(function(){try{var d=document.documentElement,m=localStorage.getItem('${THEME_STORAGE.mode}')||'system',a=localStorage.getItem('${THEME_STORAGE.accent}'),p=localStorage.getItem('${THEME_STORAGE.pack}');if(m==='dark'||(m==='system'&&matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches))d.classList.add('dark');if(a&&a!=='neutral')d.setAttribute('data-accent',a);if(p&&/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(p)){if(p==='neutral')d.removeAttribute('data-theme');else d.setAttribute('data-theme',p);}}catch(e){}})();`;

export interface ThemeScriptProps {
  /** CSP nonce, if your app uses one. */
  nonce?: string;
}

export function ThemeScript({ nonce }: ThemeScriptProps) {
  return <script nonce={nonce} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: themeBootScript }} />;
}
```

### `ui/theme/use-theme.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { THEME_STORAGE, type ThemePack } from './theme-script';

export type { ThemePack } from './theme-script';
export type ThemeMode = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';
export type ThemeAccent = 'neutral' | 'violet' | 'blue' | 'emerald' | 'rose' | 'amber' | 'orange';
export const THEME_ACCENTS: ThemeAccent[] = ['neutral', 'violet', 'blue', 'emerald', 'rose', 'amber', 'orange'];

const EVENT = 'ui:theme';
const PACK_NAME = /^[a-z0-9-]+$/;

const read = (key: string) => {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(key);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};
const write = (key: string, value: string | null) => {
  try {
    if (value === null) localStorage.removeItem(key);
    else localStorage.setItem(key, value);
  } catch {
    /* storage blocked (private mode) — the change still applies for this page */
  }
};
const systemDark = () => window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;

/** Last pack chosen in this page — keeps working when storage is blocked. */
let sessionPack: string | null = null;

function apply() {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const mode = (read(THEME_STORAGE.mode) as ThemeMode | null) ?? 'system';
  const accent = read(THEME_STORAGE.accent);
  const pack = read(THEME_STORAGE.pack) ?? sessionPack;
  // Swap without every element transitioning its colours
  const style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = '*,*::before,*::after{transition:none!important}';
  document.head.appendChild(style);
  root.classList.toggle('dark', mode === 'dark' || (mode === 'system' && systemDark()));
  if (accent && accent !== 'neutral') root.setAttribute('data-accent', accent);
  else root.removeAttribute('data-accent');
  // Nothing chosen → keep a pack the server rendered on <html>
  if (pack && PACK_NAME.test(pack)) {
    if (pack === 'neutral') root.removeAttribute('data-theme');
    else root.setAttribute('data-theme', pack);
  }
  void root.offsetHeight;
  requestAnimationFrame(() => style.remove());
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENT));
}

function subscribe(cb: () => void) {
  window.addEventListener(EVENT, cb);
  window.addEventListener('storage', cb);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener(EVENT, cb);
    window.removeEventListener('storage', cb);
  };
}

const currentPack = () => read(THEME_STORAGE.pack) ?? sessionPack ?? document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') ?? 'neutral';
const snapshot = () =>
  `${read(THEME_STORAGE.mode) ?? 'system'}|${read(THEME_STORAGE.accent) ?? 'neutral'}|${document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? 'dark' : 'light'}|${currentPack()}`;
const serverSnapshot = () => 'system|neutral|light|neutral';

/**
 * Read and change the theme from any client component.
 *   const { mode, resolvedMode, accent, pack, setMode, setAccent, setPack, toggle } = useTheme();
 */
export function useTheme() {
  const snap = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, snapshot, serverSnapshot);
  const [mode, accent, resolvedMode, pack] = snap.split('|') as [ThemeMode, ThemeAccent, 'light' | 'dark', ThemePack];

  // Follow the OS while in system mode
  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    const onChange = () => (read(THEME_STORAGE.mode) ?? 'system') === 'system' && apply();
    mq.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
  }, []);

  const setMode = useCallback((next: ThemeMode) => {
    write(THEME_STORAGE.mode, next === 'system' ? null : next);
    apply();
  }, []);
  const setAccent = useCallback((next: ThemeAccent) => {
    write(THEME_STORAGE.accent, next === 'neutral' ? null : next);
    apply();
  }, []);
  /** Built-in pack or the name of your own `[data-theme="…"]` pack ([a-z0-9-]). */
  const setPack = useCallback((next: ThemePack | (string & {})) => {
    if (!PACK_NAME.test(next)) return;
    // `neutral` is stored explicitly: it must also override a pack the server rendered
    sessionPack = next;
    write(THEME_STORAGE.pack, next);
    apply();
  }, []);
  const toggle = useCallback(() => setMode(resolvedMode === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'), [resolvedMode, setMode]);

  return { mode, resolvedMode, accent, pack, setMode, setAccent, setPack, toggle };
}
```
